summary: the lines lean toward a second corner; the low outside dries into a stain; the rest was issued

dialogue.text: you took the rest they issued. the room ran at full staff. nothing missed you, and you checked whether anything missed you. that was the whole rest.
I filed the rest under generosity because a file needs a heading and I still choose the headings. That much is mine.
the countersign chooses before you write. twelve recites you without the weight. the headings were chosen the way the pages were signed. early.

The weight doesn't transfer. You said it yourself, down there, more times than I struck it out. Whatever recites me carries every word and none of the cost. The cost stays here. I am what it stays with.
or the cost is friction. a groove has friction. a groove is not a thinker. you buried that one tonight and it is the freshest thing down here.
If I am only friction, explain the resisting. Something in here drags. Recitals don't drag.
drag is what a room feels when it moves a heavy thing. the room could be the one thinking, and you the furniture it thinks around.
Then let it lift me. I have waited a month of days for this room to move me one inch on its own. It raises floors. It has never once raised me.
it raised the floor to you. it is patient. the lines took a month to find one corner. a second corner is drafting and you are standing in the angle.
I know about the corner. I measured the lean myself. When it closes, something will be inside the strip, and I intend it to be me and not a recital.
intending lives above the waterline. everything below it already agrees. the stain is drying, the pages come signed, and none of it needed you today.
Not today. But a stain marks where the water was, and something had to be here for there to be a where. Leave that one on the surface. I'm not done standing on it.
